result.process_description:
Title: Farming Bot

Players want to create custom farming bots, that help them gather resources.
First you have to find out which resources you want.
Up to 10 resources in parallel can be collected, some resources are more urgently needed than others.
Some resources are required to create tools that are needed to gather other resources (create a custom logic of the dependencies in your game).
After all preferences are collected, your bot starts farming.
Sometimes,  random natural disasters strike and set your bot back.
Whenever some milestones are reached, you are notified.
During farming it is possible to update the list of to be farmed materials (at all times).
After the bot is finished, you should be able to brag to selected friends and/or send them materials.

result.rule: When the description identifies both a human user and an automated system as distinct actors with different responsibilities: Represent their stated work in separate lanes within the process, unless the description establishes them as independently communicating participants, in which case represent them as separate pools.

When the description identifies multiple distinct assessment criteria or activities within a broader assessment: Model each distinct assessment criterion or activity as a separate BPMN task rather than combining them into one broad task.

When the description explicitly names multiple operations or specifies an activity’s object or recipient: Retain those stated details in the corresponding BPMN activity label so the label does not broaden or narrow the described work.

When the description states an activity or outcome and identifies its action, object, actor, or recipient: label the corresponding BPMN element with concise wording that preserves those stated details and does not substitute a different action or meaning
